definitions.gloss: maki-e; gold or silver lacquer decoration
definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese lacquer technique in which a design drawn in lacquer is sprinkled with gold or silver powder, or a piece decorated this way.

examples.japanese: {蒔絵|まきえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{施|ほどこ}した→施す：12985_hodokosu⟧{硯箱|すずりばこ}。
examples.english: An inkstone box decorated with maki-e.

examples.japanese: {金粉|きんぷん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{描|えが}かれた→描く：02013_egaku⟧{蒔絵|まきえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{模様|もよう}→模様：03635_moyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{漆|うるし}→漆：10584_urushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{黒|くろ}→黒：02205_kuro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{美|うつく}しく→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{映|は}えている→映える：02393_haeru⟧。
examples.english: The maki-e design in gold powder stands out beautifully against the black lacquer.

notes:
⟦{蒔|ま}く→蒔く：02419_maku⟧ (to sprinkle) + ⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧ (picture): the metal powder is sprinkled onto wet lacquer.
